properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. From the xrt-demo genesis report (2026-09-16), F2, F3, I1, I2, in the agent's words: "separating what the user said from what the agent inferred is the single thing genesis most needs to get right — the user explicitly asked me for it, in those words." What it could do: set_provenance on Requirement, Capability, Component, Interface only — the schema declares `provenance` on those four and Fragment; six Constraints and two DesignRules quoted from the brief had nowhere to say so, and authored_by was the proxy ("authorship, not how it entered"). Every requirement's statement was verbatim the user's while its priority and concern were the agent's invention, and the node reads `authored` throughout; the caveat lived in a chat message — "exactly the private translator living outside the design that record_alias exists to abolish".

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. DECLARE `provenance` ON THE FOUR MISSING TYPES (Constraint, DesignRule, Decision, Artifact) and widen set_provenance's allowlist to what the schema declares — the cheap half, and the reach half is the class fixed today for other properties. ⚠️ Counter: `inferred` already has a precise meaning (read out of the implementation, satisfied by construction); a Constraint quoted from a brief is `authored`, and the missing word may be `quoted` versus `composed`, not a new type list.
B. PER-FIELD PROVENANCE, cheaply: an `agent_supplied: ["priority", "concern"]` list a constructor can set, so the node itself says which of its fields nobody asked the user about. ⚠️ Cost: another property on every intent type; and the constructors that DEFAULT priority already assert on the user's behalf — this would at least make the assertion visible, which req:defaults-do-not-assert asks for.
C. "WHAT DID I INFER?" AS A REPORT: every node and field the agent supplied without the user's word, in one call, so a genesis round can be audited before it is accepted. Composes with B (it reads B) and with the confirmation ledger (which already records whose word moved a status).
D. A GENESIS-FROM-FILE PATH (I1): a single-brief ingest that proposes the node set for the user to correct, making the authored/inferred split explicit by construction. ⚠️ Counter: ingest_corpus_step exists for folders and the extraction-is-two-pass decision (dec:idea-extraction-is-two-pass-against-an-se-schema-stated-up-front) already holds this question; a brief is a one-file corpus.
E. NOTHING NEW: authored_by with two contributors (the user, the agent) is the proxy and it worked. ⚠️ Counter: it answers who wrote, not how it entered, and it is per node.

═══ THE HONEST LIMIT ═══
No field-level record makes an invented priority correct; it makes it visible. That is the whole of what the provenance requirement asks for numbers, applied to words.
properties.name: OPEN — a genesis round's single most important distinction is what the USER said versus what the AGENT supplied, and today it can be recorded only per node, on four types, or in chat: should provenance reach Constraint, DesignRule, Decision and Artifact, should a node say WHICH FIELDS the agent chose (priority, concern), and should "what did I infer?" be one report a user can audit?
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill from a field report, nothing promoted. Recorded beside req:defaults-do-not-assert because the reporter's F1 (a default asserting done) and F3 (an agent asserting priority) are two ends of one scale: a value nobody chose, and a value the wrong party chose.
